# Lane 2.239: "Page not found" after adding a person, in staging

**Done.** Cause found and cured once, in the proxy; the database was never at fault.

- **Reproduced** in a real browser on the test copy as `test-copy-test.mjs` starts it (APP_ENV=staging, served made-up database, fake sign-in): after "Add to the league" the new record said "Page not found"; a reload showed it. The server log had `create_person ok` and then **no `get_person` at all** for that page: it was refused before the read.
- **Cause:** when a form's action ends in `redirect()` to our own address, Next.js 16 fetches the new page from itself at its own listening address (`__NEXT_PRIVATE_ORIGIN`, from `next start`: `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` here, `http://localhost:<port>` on a host) and streams it back with the action's answer (`next/dist/server/app-render/action-handler.js`). Node's fetch drops the forwarded Host and sends the address it calls (checked: a given `host: localhost:N` arrives as `127.0.0.1:N`). The gate (`context.ts`, `isOurHost`) rightly finds no league under that Host: `unknown-host`, "not found".
- **Ruled out, with evidence:** the database read (new test `packages/database/src/seed/served-person-read-after-add.test.ts`: add, list and read back as the same owner over `pg`'s pool on the served database, passes before and after); the id (database-made, the same in the redirect and the list); row-level security and the page's role gate (a reload as the same owner reads him).
- **Why the People tests missed it:** `people-on-database-test.mjs` does open the new record, but in APP_ENV=test, where Next's own origin (`localhost:<port>`) is the site's address; and in that mode the proxy's local-only check (`answersOnlyHere`) would refuse the self-fetch with a plain page anyway, so Next falls back to the browser. Only staging and hosted copies meet it.
- **How wide:** every form whose action ends in `redirect()` to a page behind the gate (league pages; 32 `redirect(` calls in 7 action files), in staging and on any hosted copy where the listening address is not PUBLIC_BASE_URL (every one). Each save worked; the page after it said "Page not found".
- **Fix (T-298, pending file):** `apps/web/src/server/other-host-render.ts` marks a request whose Host is not ours but whose X-Forwarded-Host is (Next writes it on the action's request and forwards it); `apps/web/src/proxy.ts` answers it with an empty 404 and no page. Given no page data, Next sends the browser to the address itself, under our host. The gate is not widened; one more round trip after a form.
- **Tests:** `other-host-render.test.ts` (3); a new check in `test-copy-test.mjs` (the owner adds a person and their record opens saying so): **failed on the build before the fix ("Page not found"), passes after (50 checks)**. `people-on-database-test` 40 checks and `people-screens-test` 97 pass; context, this-computer, people-area and isolation-coverage unit files pass (70); `npm run check`, `format:check`, typecheck pass.
- **Not verified:** a real hosted copy (none exists for the web app yet); other forms' redirects in staging were not walked one by one (same path, same cure); `next dev`. The proxy cannot see Next's `rsc` header (Next strips flight headers before the proxy), hence the forwarded-host mark.
